mapper.sql: id, reservation_id, user_id, reason, status, event_at, processed_at, notified_at, deduction_log_id, revoked_at, revoked_by, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM violation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM violation v LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = v.user_id
AND v.status = #{status} AND u.account LIKE CONCAT(#{account}, '%') AND v.event_at >= #{dateFrom} AND v.event_at < DATE_ADD(#{dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM violation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT v.id, v.reservation_id, v.user_id, v.reason, v.status, v.event_at, v.processed_at, v.notified_at, v.deduction_log_id, v.revoked_at, v.revoked_by, v.created_at FROM violation v JOIN reservation r ON r.id = v.reservation_id WHERE v.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.start_at >= #{from} AND r.start_at < #{to} ORDER BY v.id
mapper.update: UPDATE violation SET deduction_log_id = #{deductionLogId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO violation (reservation_id, user_id, reason, status, event_at, processed_at, notified_at, deduction_log_id, revoked_at, revoked_by, created_at) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{eventAt}, #{processedAt}, #{notifiedAt}, #{deductionLogId}, #{revokedAt}, #{revokedBy}, #{createdAt})
